issues.main_description_html:
Responsive Profile — new design, rebuilt on the new TS/Zustand/NativeWind stack (replaces legacy profile). See docs/brainstorm/03-06-2026/brainstorming.md.

Header

  • back bar, avatar, name + @handle, settings gear (top-right)
  • info rows: location, website, birthday
  • stats row: Posts · Follower · Following
  • actions: Follow (filled) + Hire Photographer (outlined)

About / Badge tabs

  • About tab → bio text ( https://www.figma.com/design/RSNRjxqnnr1O24SjpeoPI3/New-PANORRA-360?node-id=1122-36083&t=kox4iG9msrpyxjGx-0 )
  • Badge tab → "Top Contributor" list (location + View button) ( https://www.figma.com/design/RSNRjxqnnr1O24SjpeoPI3/New-PANORRA-360?node-id=1122-36156&t=kox4iG9msrpyxjGx-0 )

Content

  • content tabs: Post / Tagged / Bookmark
  • Justified Grid layout selector (dropdown)
  • thumbnail grid (FlashList / justified grid)

Testing Scenario (for tester)

  1. Open Profile → header shows avatar, name, @handle, location, website, birthday, and settings gear.
  2. Stats row shows Posts / Follower / Following counts.
  3. Follow toggles state; Hire Photographer is tappable.
  4. About tab is active by default → bio text renders.
  5. Switch to Badge tab → "Top Contributor" list renders, each row has a View button that navigates correctly.
  6. Switch content tabs Post / Tagged / Bookmark → each loads its own grid.
  7. Change Justified Grid selector → grid layout updates.
  8. Empty states (no posts/tagged/bookmark) show correctly; long grids scroll smoothly.
  9. Light + dark mode both readable; responsive on small + large screens.
